## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the change and any user-visible compatibility or migration impact.

## Validation

List the relevant checks actually run and their results. State prerequisites or checks that could not run.
For docs changes, include the strict build and a desktop/mobile check. Add a sanitized screenshot for UI changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and user documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] API/SDK/contract or migration changes are documented when applicable.
- [ ] Examples, logs and screenshots contain no secrets or real message data.
- [ ] Third-party additions identify their license and provenance.
